title: Revithia Stew
description: A traditional Greek stew made with revithia, a type of chickpea. This hearty dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the revithia, tomato, and oregano. Cook for 5 minutes.
Add the lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
